en: Our foes will fall!
There you are. What news from Westfall?
You, in harmony with nature, and only your skills to survive.  This is the way that the Earth Mother intended it to be.  You will want to find Bale on the Hunter Rise.
<Demitrian laughs.>$B$BYour reward is a quick and painful death, fool!
Arrrgh! This isn't right!

The Earth Mother provides, but at times, a $c needs a little extra help to survive. Thus, I am collecting all of the runecloth bandages that we can in preparation for the looming war at Ahn'Qiraj. As of now we have gathered $2089w on our way to collecting a total of $2090w.

Most of my outfit did. Displaced from the ground falling out from under our feet. Some came from other islands entirely. I came from the city of Shen'dramar, on the big island. Well, what used to be the big island, I suppose.

My family and I managed to get on one of the last skycutters out of there before the entire island broke apart. We thought that Zephras would save us. Well, it didn't. They are all long dead and now I'm here, awaiting execution.
A miner?  Ye don't need to ask if $glad : lass;, only where!  Yarr is who yer looking for, and I think ye can find him hiding out over in Steelgrill's Depot.
The Thorium Brotherhood does not waste time on ants. Be gone!

Grimnur Stonebrand will tell ye some whoppers about the one that got away, but he's still one o' the best fishermen around.  He's got a shop set up in The Forlorn Cavern called the Traveling Fisherman.
Well, I'm off then.  Take care, Harlan.
We are the only supplier of healthy flowers in all of Stormwind. We provide beautiful blooms for any occasion.
Dragon filth! Guards! Guards! Seize this monster!
Tesoran! I need someone--Falgran Hastil, preferably--to take care of $n's lead on the prints near the Shady Rest Inn.
Only if I were about five feet taller, then I would show these blasphemous demons a thing or two! Help!
My banishment is ended! Let the blood flow!
They all go to the Spire but none ever come back... just like Bijou.
Hello, $C.
Hey Jangdor - can you teach me again how to make a Wild Leather Helmet again?
Where is Elder Skygleam?
I have a rock in my nose.
%s falls to one knee. He looks exhausted.
Fiend! Face the might of Cenarius!
Bye!  Better luck next time!
It's done $n, and I think you'll be satisfied with the results.
The Kolkar invaders are retreating!
Tales of your heroics are heard throughout Ravenholdt Manor, $G Master:Mistress; $n.

There's a Bat Handler inside the Undercity.  Head south down the road out of Brill, then west at the T-intersection.  The Ruins of Lordaeron will be on your left.  Go into them and then down into the Undercity.  You can ask an Undercity Guardian there for further assistance.
Ye're beyond my skill to teach, $n. Go pester Tally Berryfizz; she's a gnome living in Tinker Town of Ironforge. Oh, and since you're headed up anyway, give Kali my love.
Who has the fastest car?  Who knows?!?
You have summoned me, fool!  Now DIE!
We will push them back, Anachronos. This I vow. Uphold your end of this task. Let not your hands falter as you seal our fates behind the barrier.

The Alliance Flag was picked up by $n!
The Iceblood Graveyard is on the south side of the Field of Strife, east of the Iceblood Tower.$B$BNeither side currently controls it.
Oh, there you are!
Stay down, Wretch!
%s scans the mill
Greetings $c, I can teach you skills and techniques.
